say: Welcome to R and B Dancehall Lovers! This is your brand new website. Thank you for trusting Siweni Solutions to build it for you. In the next few minutes, we'll walk you through your website, what it can do, and how to update it yourself, no technical skills needed.
caption: Welcome to RNB Dancehall Lovers! Thank you for trusting Siweni Solutions to build your website.

say: This is your home page. Visitors are greeted by your tagline and two big buttons: Get Tickets, and Upcoming Events.
caption: Your home page: tagline, Get Tickets and Upcoming Events buttons.

say: The Tickets on Sale section shows your ticket cards. When a fan taps one, they go straight to Megaticket or Sahwigate to pay safely and securely.
caption: Tickets on sale: fans tap a card to buy on Megaticket or Sahwigate.

say: Upcoming Events lists your next nights, with the date, the venue, and a Get Tickets button. A new event shows up here the moment you add it.
caption: Upcoming events appear here as soon as you add them.

say: As people scroll, your photos, the experience section and the floating tags bring the energy of your nights to life.
caption: Your photos and the experience section bring the vibe to life.

say: Recent Events shows your past nights. Visitors can view every event, or open the gallery to browse all your photos, full screen.
caption: Recent events and the photo gallery.

say: Every event has its own page, with the poster, the details, a ticket button, and photos from the night.
caption: Each event has its own page with poster, details and photos.

say: At the bottom of every page, people can find your email, phone number, address and Instagram.
caption: Your contact details are at the bottom of every page.

say: Here's what your website can do. It works beautifully on phones, tablets and computers. It comfortably handles around a hundred people browsing at the same moment, which is thousands of visitors a day, and Siweni can upgrade it in minutes for bigger crowds. Tickets are sold through your ticketing partners, so payments are handled safely by them. You can store thousands of photos, which are shrunk automatically. And every change you make goes live instantly.
caption: What your website can do.

say: To update your website, go to r n b dancehall lovers dot co dot z w, slash admin, and type in your password.
caption: Go to rnbdancehalllovers.co.zw/admin and enter your password.

say: The Overview page shows your next event, how many events and photos you have, and a chart of your events through the year.
caption: Overview: your next event, numbers at a glance and a yearly chart.

say: To add an event, open Events. Type the event name, pick the date and time, and add the venue. Then open your event on Megaticket, copy the address from the top of your browser, and paste it into Where to buy tickets. Add a short description and your poster, then press Add event. That's it, it's live on your website straight away.
caption: Adding an event: name, date, venue, ticket page, poster, then Add event.

say: After the night, press Photos on the event to upload your pictures. You can add up to twenty at a time, straight from your phone, and pick one to be the cover.
caption: Press Photos on an event to upload pictures from the night.

say: The Photos page is for your experience photos and highlights. The newest three experience photos appear on your home page. You can add captions, or delete any photo.
caption: Photos: experience photos and highlights for your gallery.

say: Website Details is where you change your home page text, contact details, social media links, and your two ticket cards. Just press Save changes when you're done.
caption: Website details: text, contact, social media and ticket cards.

say: You can watch this video again any time, from the Help button at the top of your admin panel. If you ever need a hand, the Siweni team is always here to help. Enjoy your new website, and here's to many more unforgettable nights!
caption: Watch again any time from the Help button. Enjoy your new website!
